proposal.name: SITE00 Platform Capability Registry

phase_1.what: Check this genome in as data: src/site00/platform/capabilities.registry.json (or docs/site00/capability-genome/SITE00_CAPABILITY_GENOME.json promoted to canon), with a TypeScript type and loader.

phase_2.what: CI contract test: every capability marked EXISTS_* must have its current_locations resolve to real files. Every API handler must map to a capability with a declared security_class (this is the same check as the WP02 route-policy declaration). Every table must be claimed by a capability (this catches the 41 orphan tables).

phase_3.what: Founder CONTROL ROOM view (read-only): heatmap, blockers and engine status from the registry, so the next sprint starts from data.

proposal.governance: The registry is CANON_REGISTRY data. A sprint that changes a capability updates its record in the same PR. Status changes need evidence (file:line), the same rule this audit used.
proposal.not_now: No database table for the registry before client #1. Repo data plus a CI check is enough and avoids another unmaintained store.
